name: Sangarm Jena

sections.heading: Life and writing.
paragraphs: Sangram Jena writes poetry in Odia and English and works as a translator and literary editor. Contributor notes in The Antonym and Borderless identify his editorial work with Nishant in Odia and Marg Asia in English. His English collection Poems of Passion was published by Sarup and Sons in 2008.

In ‘There I Live’, the village first takes shape through rain, cattle dust, paddy fields and kash flowers. The scene gradually becomes an inward geography: familiar places hold separation, unspoken wishes and the longing for another person's touch. Its movement from a visible landscape into isolation gives the poem its quiet tension.
